decisions.reason: It shows clear realized value through named government use and broad APIS connectivity, so the option has moved beyond early uncertainty and fits a scalable core security offering.

After two years with no visible evidence of market traction, and with travel-health compliance likely a narrower and less durable niche, the remaining option value appears limited relative to alternative uses of resources.

Travel and document verification remains closely tied to the firm's core security and compliance capabilities, and as a digital platform it is relatively inexpensive to keep open while commercial potential continues to develop.
